libraries.heading: Open-Source Libraries
libraries.intro: GoWorks uses the following open-source libraries. Each library's license is available in its own project repository.

company.heading: Company Information
company.description: Brand details shown in the app header, email notifications, and the login screen. Changes are saved automatically.

companyName.label: Company name
companyName.helperWith: Shown in the header as "{{name}} Workspace Management".
companyName.helperEmpty: When left empty, the header shows only "GoWorks · Workspace Management".

sidebarAbbr.label: Sidebar abbreviation
sidebarAbbr.helper: If left empty, it is generated automatically from the initials of the company name. Preview:

allowedDomain.label: Allowed email domain
allowedDomain.helperWith: Only email addresses ending with this domain can sign in to the application.
allowedDomain.helperEmpty: ⚠ Empty — currently any Workspace account can sign in. Set your domain right after the first admin login.
allowedDomain.helperBlur: Changes are saved when you leave the field.
allowedDomain.requiredError: Allowed domain is required. It cannot be empty.

emailSenderName.label: Email notification sender name
emailSenderName.helper: Appears as "{{name}}" in the subject and body of the email sent when a bulk job completes.

language.heading: Application Language
language.description: Change the UI language from here or via the switch in the top-right corner.
language.label: Language

logo.heading: Logo
logo.description: Shown at the top of the sidebar as the company logo. PNG / JPG / SVG / WEBP, max 1 MB.
logo.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete the logo?

googleCloud.title: Google OAuth Credentials
googleCloud.subtitle: The Desktop OAuth Client ID and Secret you created in Cloud Console. The secret is stored encrypted in the OS keychain and is never shown on screen.

requiredApis.title: Required Google APIs
requiredApis.subtitle: The following APIs must be enabled in Cloud Console for Workspace features to work. Click a row to open its Cloud Console page.

serviceAccount.heading: Google Service Account
serviceAccount.description: Required for Gmail signature management via Domain-wide Delegation. Your JSON key is stored locally under userData/secrets/.
serviceAccount.notConfiguredHelp: Upload your Google Cloud Service Account JSON key below.
serviceAccount.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete the Service Account key? Signature management will be disabled.
serviceAccount.selectJsonFile: Please select a .json Service Account key file

dwd.heading: Domain-Wide Delegation
dwd.description: The Service Account must be authorized in Admin Console for these OAuth scopes to act domain-wide.
dwd.clientIdMissing: Upload the Service Account JSON first to display its Client ID.
dwd.testHelper: The test verifies that the Service Account can read admin.directory.user as {{adminEmail}}.

unauthorizedClientHint.heading: What to do:
unauthorizedClientHint.step2: Click "Open Admin Console", add a new client to the DWD list.
unauthorizedClientHint.step3: Paste the scope list (Copy All) and save, then run the test again.

resetWizard.heading: Setup Wizard
resetWizard.description: Restart the onboarding wizard if you'd like to walk through the steps again. Existing configuration is preserved; only the wizard reopens.
resetWizard.confirm: Restart the setup wizard? Your existing settings will be preserved.

titles.csvFormat: The first row must be a header (name or unvan); enter one title per line below.

institutions.csvFormat: Columns (in order): name, address, phone — comma-separated. The first row must be a header (name,address,phone). Address and phone are optional.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Settings page consists of five tabs: General, Titles, Institutions, Google Workspace Settings and About. From these tabs you manage the app's branding, the Google Workspace connection settings, and the reference data used in the New User / signature flow.

sections.heading: General Tab
paragraphs: Company name, sidebar abbreviation, logo, email notification sender name, allowed sign-in domain and the app language are set here.

callout.text: When branding info is changed, the sidebar and header update instantly; the same app is adapted to different organizations from this tab.

sections.heading: Titles Tab
paragraphs: Manage the list of titles that can be assigned to users (Manager, Teacher, etc.) here, and add several at once with the Bulk add button. Defined titles are selected on the New User page and used in the signature template as the {{unvan}} variable.

sections.heading: Institutions Tab
paragraphs: Each institution's name, address and phone are defined here. Defined institutions are selected on the New User page and appear in the signature template as the {{kurum_adi}}, {{kurum_adres}} and {{kurum_telefon}} variables. You can add several at once with the Bulk add button.

callout.text: The Institutions feature is meant for organizations with multiple branches or locations. Each branch/location is defined as a separate institution, so every user's signature carries their own branch details. Single-location companies can define just one institution.

sections.heading: Google Workspace Settings Tab
paragraphs: Google Cloud OAuth credentials, required APIs, the Service Account and Domain-Wide Delegation configuration, and the onboarding reset live on this tab. The Service Account and DWD are required for signature management.

sections.heading: About Tab
paragraphs: The application version, license (Apache 2.0), trademark notices, and the open-source libraries used are listed here.
